verdict.label: Worth checking
verdict.headline: Supertubos Lunch
verdict.reason: Supertubos is worth a quick check for lunch, but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  The wind should be manageable, but not a big advantage.  The tide is lining up for a powerful wedge, so keep the comfort level in mind.

conversationalSummary.text: For TODAY, I’d treat it as a worth-checking day at Supertubos around lunch, but I’m not expecting it to be super consistent. The cams (Surfline and MEO Beachcam for your preferred setups) are the key check before you leave, because Surfline looks a bit “lully” on reliability. Wind is mixed and could turn cross-off, and with the tide rising you’re more likely to get that pushy, punchy sandbar setup—so only go if the cams look noticeably better than you’re expecting.

best.explanation: Supertubos looks like a fun-sized window for Worth checking, Medium confidence: 0.6-0.9 m, 62 kJ, 10 s period, lully 22/100, and wind is not fully clear.  A fast, hollow sand-bottom wave that gets serious quickly; this is best for short, punchy bodyboard barrels when it is small enough for comfort; 10-13s at mid tide is the prime barrel / wedge setup for Supertubos / Molhe Leste; worth keeping on the radar because Surfline is showing it above Poor while most other local spots are Poor..  Watch: Surfline consistency is lully.
